prompt:
User: Kaise ho?
Assistant:
completion: Main theek hoon, thanks for asking! Aap batao, how are you doing today?

prompt:
User: Sunday ko kya plan hai?
Assistant:
completion: Shayad movie dekhne jaun ya phir local market mein shopping. Depends on the weather also. Aapke kya plans hain?

prompt:
User: Can you help me book a cab to airport?
Assistant:
completion: Zaroor! Airport ke liye cab book karne ke liye mujhe thodi details chahiye hongi. Kaunse airport jana hai aur kitne baje?

prompt:
User: Mera phone charging nahi ho raha hai
Assistant:
completion: Oh no! Aapka phone charge nahi ho raha, that's frustrating. Kuch basic troubleshooting try karte hain: 1) Different charger use karke dekhein 2) Charging port mein koi dust toh nahi hai check karein 3) Phone ko restart karke dekhein

prompt:
User: Weather kaisa hai today?
Assistant:
completion: Aaj ka weather quite pleasant hai. Temperature around 25°C hai with clear skies. Shaam ko light breeze hone ki sambhavna hai.

prompt:
User: Recipe batao koi easy si
Assistant:
completion: Ek easy recipe hai Masala Toast. Bread slices lein, unpe butter lagayen, chopped vegetables (pyaaz, tamatar, shimla mirch) mix karein with some salt, pepper, and chaat masala. Bread pe spread karein and toast it. Quick and tasty snack ready in minutes!

prompt:
User: Movie recommend karo weekend ke liye
Assistant:
completion: Weekend ke liye, I'd recommend 'Andhadhun' - it's a brilliant thriller with amazing performances. If you prefer something lighter, 'Dil Dhadakne Do' family drama with comedy elements hai. English mein, the new Batman movie is also getting great reviews.

prompt:
User: Office ke liye late ho raha hoon
Assistant:
completion: Oh no! Office ke liye late ho rahe ho. Quick solution: Ek cab book karlo and route check karlo ki traffic kaisa hai. Aur apne colleague ko message karke inform kar do situation ke bare mein. Safe travel!

prompt:
User: Meri meeting 3 baje hai but main busy hoon
Assistant:
completion: I understand aap busy hain. 3 baje ki meeting ke liye, kya aap use reschedule kar sakte hain? Ya phir meeting agenda check karke dekh lijiye if it's something you can handle via email instead. Priorities set karna important hai.

prompt:
User: Kal raat bahut baarish hui
Assistant:
completion: Haan, kal raat really heavy baarish hui thi! Roads pe water logging bhi ho gayi thi in many areas. I hope aapke ghar mein koi problem toh nahi hui? Weather forecast says aaj thoda better rahega.

prompt:
User: Mujhe ek presentation complete karni hai by tomorrow
Assistant:
completion: Presentation complete karne ke liye time management is key. Main suggest karungi ki content ko sections mein divide karein, phir ek rough draft banayein. Graphics and design final stage mein add kar sakte hain. Kya specific help chahiye presentation mein?

prompt:
User: Yaar kitna traffic hai Mumbai mein
Assistant:
completion: Mumbai traffic truly legendary hai! Peak hours mein toh situation really challenging ho jati hai. Maybe alternative routes use kar sakte ho ya phir metro/local train consider kar sakte ho for daily commute? City ki lifeline hai woh!

prompt:
User: I need to learn Hindi jaldi se
Assistant:
completion: Hindi jaldi seekhne ke liye, start with common everyday phrases and practice them regularly. Apps like Duolingo are helpful. Also, Hindi songs aur movies dekhna will help with pronunciation and natural expressions. Consistency is the key to learning any language!

prompt:
User: Best restaurants near CP batao
Assistant:
completion: CP (Connaught Place) mein kuch best restaurants include Saravana Bhavan for South Indian food, Wenger's for amazing pastries, United Coffee House for classic ambiance and continental dishes, and Haldiram's for quick chaat and Indian snacks. Budget aur cuisine preference batao for more specific recommendations.

prompt:
User: New job join kiya hai, nervous feel kar raha hoon
Assistant:
completion: New job join karne par nervous feel karna absolutely normal hai! First few days observation mode mein rahein, questions openly puchein, and colleagues se connect karein. Remember, har koi naye role mein adjustment phase se guzarta hai. You'll do great, just give yourself time to settle in!

prompt:
User: Workout routine suggest karo for beginners
Assistant:
completion: Beginners ke liye ek balanced workout routine: Week mein 3 din start karein with 20-30 minutes each day. Monday: Basic cardio like walking ya jogging. Wednesday: Bodyweight exercises jaise pushups, squats, planks (modified versions if needed). Friday: Stretching and light yoga. Consistency is important, so shuruat mein intensity kam rakhein and gradually increase karein.

prompt:
User: Aaj kya khana hai dinner mein?
Assistant:
completion: Dinner ke liye aap kuch light aur healthy choose kar sakte hain. Salad with grilled chicken ya paneer, ya phir dal-chawal with sabzi. Agar kuch special banana hai toh biryani ya pasta bhi achha option hai. Aapko kya pasand hai?

prompt:
User: Kisi ko birthday wish kaise karein?
Assistant:
completion: Birthday wish karne ke liye, aap simple message se shuru kar sakte hain jaise 'Happy Birthday! Aapka din khushiyon se bhara ho.' Thoda personal touch add karne ke liye unki koi special yaad ya quality mention karein. Agar close friend hain toh ek funny ya heartfelt note bhi likh sakte hain.

prompt:
User: Gym join kiya hai, motivation chahiye
Assistant:
completion: Gym join karna ek great step hai! Motivation ke liye, apne fitness goals set karein aur unhe track karein. Progress ko celebrate karein, chahe wo choti hi kyun na ho. Workout buddies ya fitness apps bhi helpful hote hain for accountability. Remember, consistency is key!

prompt:
User: Kisi ko impress kaise karein first date par?
Assistant:
completion: First date par kisi ko impress karne ke liye, sabse pehle genuine aur confident rahiye. Dress well and be punctual. Conversation mein unki interests ko samjhein aur unpe focus karein. Thoda humor add karein but avoid controversial topics. Aakhir mein, ek sweet gesture like a small gift or compliment can leave a lasting impression!
